cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 84% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.91%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.21%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +7.32%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +7.32%, OKLO +6.79%, TLN +5.76%, VRT +5.68%, EOSE +5.62%. Laggards: ETR -0.97%, NEE -0.67%, MPLX -0.19%.
